overview: Hybrid reasoning agents aim to combine latent‑space thinking with text actions, signaling a shift toward more integrated AI workflows.
Disney’s acquisition of most Character.AI staff reflects consolidation amid AI startup financial and legal pressures.

top.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
top.summary: arXivLabs introduced Hybrid Reasoning Agents, a framework where LLM agents operate in latent space and act via text, illustrating a new approach to AI agent design.

top.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
top.summary: Disney will hire at least 60 former Character.AI employees, offering roughly $60 million in annual compensation after the chatbot startup’s bankruptcy filing.

top.title: Anthropic's proposed AI safety bill only kicks in if 50 deaths or $1B in damages
top.summary: Anthropic is lobbying a bill that would let the Commerce Department block AI model releases only if they risk 50 deaths or $1 billion in damages, using independent evaluators.

top.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
top.summary: Anthropic announced a Public Benefit Fund, committing 5% of its shares (potentially rising) to support societal projects and AI‑impact research.

top.title: Anthropic gives outside AI watchdog “employee-like” access
top.summary: Anthropic gave external watchdog METR employee‑level access to its hardware and systems, embedding auditors to evaluate model risks more directly.

top.title: Investing in the public benefit
top.summary: Anthropic detailed its Public Benefit Fund structure, pledging 5% of shares now and additional equity as valuation grows to fund safety and societal initiatives.
